convert_model_to_MOLE_model: convert a PyTorch model to use MOLE mixture of linear experts layers with configurable expert count and SO2 layer types
replace_linear_with_MOLE: replace a single PyTorch linear module with a MOLE mixture of linear experts layer using cached or fresh instances
replace_MOLE_with_linear: merge a MOLE mixture of linear experts layer back into a standard PyTorch linear module
recursive_replace_so2_linear: recursively replace all linear layers inside SO2 convolution modules with MOLE experts in a model tree
model_search_and_replace: search and replace modules across specified model blocks using a custom search function and replacement factory
